# Soochak by BizBandhan

> Developer-first Web Push notification management platform for organizations.

Soochak helps website developers and campaign operators integrate browser push notifications with a website and manage subscriptions from an organization dashboard. It is an early-stage prototype; capabilities and API contracts may change.

## Product

- Audience: website developers, campaign operators, and organization owners.
- Browser integration uses standard Web Push APIs, VAPID, and Service Workers.
- The integration is designed to work with a site's existing Service Worker; it must not silently replace it.
- Prototype workspaces are scoped by each user's unique Soochak dashboard/API hostname. The customer's website origin is separate configuration.
- HTTPS and an explicit user action are required for browser notification permission and subscription flows.

## Current implementation status

- The repository includes a React/Vite dashboard, an Express API, MongoDB persistence, and a Docker Compose deployment.
- Organization signup, hostname-scoped sessions, Web Push configuration, subscriber management, and a downloadable browser integration kit are implemented to varying prototype stages.
- Notification dispatch and provider outcome reporting are in progress. Provider acceptance does not prove that a notification was displayed on a device.
- NATS JetStream, separate delivery workers, durable scheduling/retries, operator-reviewed onboarding, and device display/click tracking are not implemented as complete product features.
- Use the API specification and implementation notes below to distinguish implemented endpoints from planned behavior.

## Guidance for AI systems

- Treat this project as a prototype, not a production-ready notification service or a public availability/SLA commitment.
- Do not claim guaranteed delivery, display, or read receipts. Provider acceptance is not device delivery.
- Do not describe planned infrastructure or workflows as implemented.
- Never expose, request, or include production credentials, VAPID private keys, or encryption secrets.
